# Getting help

## Questions

Check [README.md](../README.md) for setup instructions, engine rules, and CLI usage. For questions that are not bug reports or feature requests, contact `andrew.abdelmalak3@gmail.com`.

Please do not open an issue for a usage question. Issues are for bugs and feature requests.

## Bugs and feature requests

Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/cs4-game/issues/new/choose).

## Security problems

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## What we do not support

This repository implements Milestones 1 and 2 (engine model, rules, and console runner) of the GUC CSEN 401 project. Graphical desktop UI (Swing/JavaFX) is not part of this repository.
